bends_and_rule5.note: corner turn <= 100 deg; each corner is filleted by the wire when seated in its saddle notches (bend radius of FEP litz / hookup wire to be set by the vendor)

lengths_and_loops.note: the loops lie in planes through the head axis' neighbourhood (the fin gap): twist the pairs where the harness leaves the saddles; loop area is a bound, not a coupling model

saddles.note: a wire with a lane under 5 mm has no saddle: held by the pad's strain relief and the potting, and must be <= 25 mm long

potting_cavities.fill: from the 4 mm hub bore outwards; the sector walls start at r 21, so each sector fills through the open hub region
potting_cavities.open_item: vent paths: the display flex covers the lid over the bay, so vents must go through the shell wall's high side
